name: Pizza Palazzo
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Pizza Palazzo in Tirol!**

Discover authentic Italian flair in the heart of the Alps. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, our wood-fired pizzas bring the taste of Italy to **Tirol**.

Indulge in our delicious **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert—crispy on the outside, fluffy inside, and dusted with powdered sugar. Pair it with a cup of **Eiskaffee** (a Tiroler specialty) for the perfect sweet finish.

Located in the vibrant city of **Innsbruck**, we’re just a short stroll from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the charming **Altstadt**. Stop by for a quick lunch or an evening feast—your taste buds will thank you!

**Pizza Palazzo – Where Italian passion meets Tiroler hospitality.**
